sentences.en: In 1989, Japan's Shinkansen bullet train had a problem.
sentences.zh: 1989年，日本的新干线子弹头列车遇到一个问题。

sentences.en: It was fast, really fast, like pushing 170 miles per hour faSt.
sentences.zh: 它速度极快，真的极快，时速能逼近170英里。

sentences.en: But every time it exited a tunnel, it was loud.
sentences.zh: 但每次它驶出隧道时，声音都非常大。

sentences.en: The noise was coming from a variety of sources, but whenever a train sped into a tunnel,
sentences.zh: 这种噪音来自各种源头，每当列车高速冲进隧道时，

sentences.en: it pushed waves of atmospheric pressure through the other end.
sentences.zh: 它就会把大气压力波推向隧道的另一端。

sentences.en: The air exited tunnels with a sonic boom that could be heard 400 meters away.
sentences.zh: 空气带着一声响爆离开隧道，400米外都能听到。

sentences.en: In dense residential areas, that was a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 在人口稠密的居民区，这是个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: So an engineering team was brought in to design a quieter, faster, and more efficient train.
sentences.zh: 于是，工程团队被请来设计一辆更安静、更快、更高效的列车。

sentences.en: And they had one secret weapon.
sentences.zh: 而他们有一个秘密武器。

sentences.en: Eiji Nakatsu, the general manager of the technical development department, was a birdwatcher.
sentences.zh: 技术开发部门总经理中津英治是个观鸟爱好者。

sentences.en: Different components of the redesigned bullet train were based on different birds.
sentences.zh: 重新设计的子弹头列车的不同部件，都是以不同的鸟类为原型的。

sentences.en: Owls inspired the pantograph.
sentences.zh: 猫头鹰启发了受电弓的设计。

sentences.en: That's the rig that connects the train to the electric wires above.
sentences.zh: 也就是把列车连接到上方电线的那个装置。

sentences.en: Nekatsu modeled the redesign after their feathers, reducing noise by using the same serrations and curvature
sentences.zh: 中津根据它们的羽毛对外形进行了重新设计，利用相同的锯齿状边缘和曲率来降低噪音，

sentences.en: that allowed them to silently swoop down to catch prey.
sentences.zh: 正是这些特征让猫头鹰能够无声地俯冲捕捉猎物。

sentences.en: The Adeli penguin, whose smooth body allows it to swim and slide effortlessly,
sentences.zh: 阿德利企鹅光滑的身体让它能够毫不费力地游泳和滑行，

sentences.en: inspired the pantograph's supporting shaft, redesigned for lower wind resistance.
sentences.zh: 这启发了受电弓支撑杆的设计，经重新设计以降低风阻。

sentences.en: And perhaps most notable of all was the kingfisher.
sentences.zh: 也许其中最引人注目的还是翠鸟。

sentences.en: The kingfisher is a bird that dives into water to catch its prey.
sentences.zh: 翠鸟是一种潜入水中捕捉猎物的鸟。

sentences.en: The unique shape of its beak allows it to do that while barely making a splash.
sentences.zh: 其独特的喙部形状使它在入水时几乎不会溅起水花。

sentences.en: Nakatsu took that shape to the design table.
sentences.zh: 中津把这个形状带到了设计桌上。

sentences.en: The team shot bullets shaped like different train nose models down a pipe to measure pressure waves,
sentences.zh: 团队将仿照不同列车车头模型制成的子弹射入管道以测量压力波，

sentences.en: and dropped them into water to measure the splash size.
sentences.zh: 并将其投入水中以测量水花大小。

sentences.en: The quietest nose design was the one modeled most closely after the kingfisher's beak.
sentences.zh: 最安静的车头设计，正是那个最贴近翠鸟喙部造型的模型。

sentences.en: When the redesign debuted in 1997, it was 10% faster, used 15% less electricity,
sentences.zh: 当这个重新设计的列车在1997年首次亮相时，它的速度提升了10%，耗电量减少了15%，

sentences.en: and stayed under the 70 decibel noise limit in residential areas.
sentences.zh: 并且将居民区的噪音控制在70分贝的限制以下。

sentences.en: And it did all that with the wings of an owl, the belly of a penguin, and the nose of a kingfisher.
sentences.zh: 它做到这一切，凭借的是猫头鹰的翅膀、企鹅的腹部以及翠鸟的车头。

sentences.en: There's a name for design like this.
sentences.zh: 这种设计有一个名字。

sentences.en: It's called biomimicry.
sentences.zh: 它被称为仿生学。

sentences.en: The people who design our world usually never take a biology class, believe it or not.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，设计我们这个世界的人通常从来不上生物课。

sentences.en: So they're novices in how the world works.
sentences.zh: 所以对于世界是如何运作的，他们其实是新手。

sentences.en: That's Janine Benyus.
sentences.zh: 这位是珍妮·本尤斯。

sentences.en: Back in 1997, she wrote the book that coined the term biomimicry.
sentences.zh: 早在1997年，她就撰写了创造“仿生学”这个词的书籍。

sentences.en: It told the story of the innovations in computing, energy, and health
sentences.zh: 书里讲述了计算机、能源和健康领域的创新故事，

sentences.en: that were inspired by structures in the natural world.
sentences.zh: 这些创新都受到了自然界中结构的启发。

sentences.en: Stick like a gecko.
sentences.zh: 像壁虎一样黏附。

sentences.en: Compute like a cell.
sentences.zh: 像细胞一样计算。

sentences.en: Even run a business like a redwood foreSt.
sentences.zh: 甚至像红杉林那样经营企业。

sentences.en: Benyus has since worked as a consultant for various companies,
sentences.zh: 此后，本尤斯一直担任各种公司的顾问，

sentences.en: trying to get them to understand how to take design ideas from nature.
sentences.zh: 试图让他们理解如何从大自然中汲取设计灵感。

sentences.en: That might mean studying prairie dog burrows to build better air ventilation systems,
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着研究草原犬鼠的洞穴来建造更好的空气通风系统，

sentences.en: mimicking shark skin to create bacteria-resistant plastic surfaces for hospitals,
sentences.zh: 模仿鲨鱼皮为医院创造抗细菌的塑料表面，

sentences.en: or arranging wind turbines in the same drag-reducing pattern that schools of fish swim in.
sentences.zh: 或者按照鱼群游泳时那样的减阻模式来排列风力涡轮机。

sentences.en: Designers get inspiration from a lot of different places,
sentences.zh: 设计师从许多不同的地方获得灵感，

sentences.en: but Benyus thinks many of them could benefit from looking more at the natural world.
sentences.zh: 但本尤斯认为，他们中的很多人如果能更多地观察自然界，将会受益匪浅。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of sort of looking at what other people have done.
sentences.zh: 所以大家基本上都在看别人做过什么。

sentences.en: And what they do is they look at all the others and they get ideas.
sentences.zh: 他们的做法就是看别人的成果然后获取灵感。

sentences.en: They literally do, you know, a lot of designers have lots of magazines that they look through.
sentences.zh: 他们真的会这样做，你知道的，很多设计师翻阅各种各样的杂志。

sentences.en: They tear those out.
sentences.zh: 他们把那些页面撕下来。

sentences.en: They put them on inspiration boards.
sentences.zh: 把它们贴在灵感板上。

sentences.en: But they're looking at other human technologies.
sentences.zh: 但他们看的都是其他人类的技术。

sentences.en: Her idea was simple.
sentences.zh: 她的想法很简单。

sentences.en: Designers should get in the habit of bringing a biologist to the table
sentences.zh: 设计师应该养成带一个生物学家上谈判桌的习惯，

sentences.en: and let them help solve problems by mimicking nature.
sentences.zh: 让他们通过模仿大自然来协助解决问题。

sentences.en: And there are three main ways they can do that.
sentences.zh: 他们可以通过三种主要方式做到这一点。

sentences.en: You know, you can mimic its form or its shape.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以模仿它的形态或形状。

sentences.en: You might create a paint for a building that when it dries,
sentences.zh: 你可能会为建筑创造一种涂料，当它干燥时，

sentences.en: it's got the same structure as self-cleaning leaves.
sentences.zh: 它拥有与自清洁叶片相同的结构。

sentences.en: Lotus leaves are notoriously great.
sentences.zh: 莲叶在这方面非常出名。

sentences.en: They let rainwater clean the leaf because they have these bumps.
sentences.zh: 它们让雨水清洗叶子，因为它们有这些微小的突起。

sentences.en: The rainwater balls up on the bumps and then it purls away the dirt.
sentences.zh: 雨水在这些突起上聚成水珠，然后把污垢滚落带走。

sentences.en: So that lotus effect is physical.
sentences.zh: 所以这种荷叶效应是物理层面的。

sentences.en: And you can create a physical structure on the outside of any product.
sentences.zh: 你可以在任何产品的外部创造出这种物理结构。

sentences.en: Imagine that on the outside of your car.
sentences.zh: 想象一下把它用在你的汽车外壳上。

sentences.en: Rainwater would clean your car.
sentences.zh: 雨水就能帮你洗车了。

sentences.en: So that's mimicking form.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是模仿形态。

sentences.en: But there's also a mimicking process, the processes in the natural world.
sentences.zh: 但还有模仿过程，即自然界中的过程。

sentences.en: It might even be, you know, how you mimic how ants communicate
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是，你知道的，模仿蚂蚁如何进行交流，

sentences.en: in order to efficiently find sources of food or new places to live.
sentences.zh: 以便高效地寻找食物来源或新的栖息地。

sentences.en: And those processes, that self-organization, has been mimicked in software.
sentences.zh: 这些过程，即这种自组织能力，已经在软件中得到了模仿。

sentences.en: You know, in things like, you know, autonomous cars
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如自动驾驶汽车，

sentences.en: and how they're going to move in flocks through the city by talking to one another.
sentences.zh: 以及它们将如何通过互相通信在城市中成群结队地移动。

sentences.en: That's mimicking nature's process.
sentences.zh: 这就是模仿大自然的过程。

sentences.en: And then you jump up to the level of mimicking whole ecosystems, right?
sentences.zh: 然后你再提升到模仿整个生态系统的层面，对吧？

sentences.en: There's a thing called, that's a buzzword right now that's really hot,
sentences.zh: 现在有个词很火，是个大热的流行语，

sentences.en: called the circular economy, which is essentially, you know,
sentences.zh: 叫做循环经济，本质上就是，你知道的，

sentences.en: industry saying, you know, there are, there should be no such thing as a byproduct
sentences.zh: 工业界在说，我们的制造设施里不应该存在，

sentences.en: in our manufacturing facility that goes to landfill.
sentences.zh: 任何最终被送往垃圾填埋场的副产品。

sentences.en: It should be used by something else, right?
sentences.zh: 它应该被其他东西利用，对吧？

sentences.en: And at the end of a product's life, that product should be upcycled into something else.
sentences.zh: 而且在一个产品的生命周期结束时，该产品应该被升级改造为别的东西。

sentences.en: It's being called the circular economy.
sentences.zh: 这就叫做循环经济。

sentences.en: Ecosystems do that really, really, really well.
sentences.zh: 生态系统在这方面做得非常非常之好。

sentences.en: You've got a log on the forest floor,
sentences.zh: 森林地面上有一根原木，

sentences.en: and those materials move up into the body of the fungus that eats it.
sentences.zh: 这些物质会转移到吃它的真菌体内。

sentences.en: Those materials move up into a mouse.
sentences.zh: 这些物质接着转移到老鼠体内。

sentences.en: And that mouse material moves up into a hawk, right?
sentences.zh: 然后这只老鼠体内的物质又转移到了鹰的体内，对吧？

sentences.en: And if you think about that as what we'd like to do with local materials
sentences.zh: 如果你把这看作是我们希望对本地材料做的事情，

sentences.en: being upcycled constantly in our cities, for instance,
sentences.zh: 例如在我们的城市中不断进行升级再造，

sentences.en: those ecosystem lessons are really big for us.
sentences.zh: 那么这些生态系统的教训对我们来说意义重大。

sentences.en: And that's the end goal for biomimetic design, making products, systems, and cities
sentences.zh: 这就是仿生设计的最终目标，让产品、系统和城市

sentences.en: functionally indistinguishable from the natural world.
sentences.zh: 在功能上与自然界无法区分。

sentences.en: Life has been around on Earth for 3.8 billion years.
sentences.zh: 生命在地球上已经存在了38亿年。

sentences.en: And what designers are starting to realize is that that is a lot of research and development time.
sentences.zh: 而设计师们开始意识到，这是一段相当漫长的研发时间。

sentences.en: The people who design our world have a lot to learn from the natural world.
sentences.zh: 设计我们这个世界的人，有很多东西需要向大自然学习。

sentences.en: All they have to do is take a look.
sentences.zh: 他们需要做的只是看上一眼。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for watching.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的观看。

sentences.en: This is one in a series of videos that Vox is doing in partnership with 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这是Vox与99% Invisible合作推出的系列视频之一。

sentences.zh: 如果你想观看更多此类视频，可以前往 youtube.com/Vox。
